Subject: Interactive mosaic pod — shelving, signage, and demo kit order

Team,

We're locking the design for the interactive mosaic pod for CloudCon. GreenLeaf sent the rough layout; before I approve the quote I need:

- Confirmation on the internal shelving heights (we need 2 tiers for demo units and 1 for swags)
- Signage dimensions for the front fascia and hanging blade
- Shipping lead time and whether they can pre-build crates

Can you review the attached vendor spec and highlight any must-haves or cost drivers? I'm aiming to approve by end of day Tuesday so procurement can cut a PO.

Thanks,
Kim

Kimberly Park
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0182
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interactive mosaic pod — shelving, signage, and demo kit order

Kim,

Quick notes after scanning the vendor spec:

- Shelving: 2 tiers fine; request adjustable shelf brackets (+$45) to accommodate thicker demo units.
- Signage: front fascia max 36" x 10"; hanging blade should be 24" x 48" (double-sided). Confirm we want backlighting — it'll add ~$320.
- Crate build: vendor can pre-build and palletize; adds 5 business days.

I'll flag adjustable brackets and backlighting as optional in my comments on the quote. Logan — anything on AV power or demo cable length?

-Marissa
From: GreenLeaf Exhibits <sales@greenleafexhibits.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mila Park <mila@eventexpo.com>

Subject: Re: Interactive mosaic pod — quote GL-4567 and lead times

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the notes. Attached are the updated specs (mosaic_pod_specs.pdf) and a line-item quote (quote_GL_4567.xlsx).

Summary of changes and costs:
- Adjustable shelf brackets (2) — $90
- Front fascia printed vinyl (36x10) — $210
- Hanging blade double-sided (24x48) — $420
- Optional LED backlight for fascia — $320
- Pre-build, crate & pallet — $650 (includes skids)
- 4-week lead time from PO receipt; express 3-week available at +20%.

Attachment stubs: [mosaic_pod_specs.pdf (PDF) — 1.2MB], [quote_GL_4567.xlsx (XLSX) — 8k rows redacted]

Let us know which options to include and we'll issue a final invoice and lead time confirmation.

Best,
